s: Mi hem hachayyabim bitpillin vehappeturim ubo y"a seipim: choleh meayim — patur min hattepillin, apillu en lo tzaar, vaapillu holek bashshevaqim ubarechobot, mippene sheen yakol lizzaher bahen heteb lishmor et atzmo binqiyyut. Veen lo lehachamir al atzmo bazeh ella bishat qeriat shema utepilla, vehu shennireh lo sheyyakol lehaamid et atzmo begup naqi (veketzad yaaseh mi sheeno yakol lehishshamer et atzmo mehapiach bishat hattepilla — yitbaer besiman p):
Abal shear choleh, im mitztaer becholyo veen dato meyushshebet alayv mippene tzaaro — patur, mippene sheasur lehassiach dato mehen. Veim lav — chayyab, ap al pi shehu choleh:

Nashim vaabadim kenaanim — peturim mittepillin, mippene shehu mitzvat aseh shehazzeman gerama, shehare shabbat veyom tob enan zeman tepillin. Veim ratzu hannashim lehachamir al atzman velahanichan — mochin beyadan, mippene sheenan yodeot lishmor et atzman binqiyyut:

Hammeniach tepillin tzarik lizzaher mehirhur taavat haishsha, veim i epshar lo belo hirhurim — tob shello lahanicham. Vehu sheyyadua lo bevadday shei epshar shello yeharher, abal missapeq lo yimmana mimmitzvat tepillin:

Abel beyom rishon shel abelut, dehaynu beyom haqqebura — asur lehaniach tepillin, mippene shehattepillin niqrain peer, shenneemar: "peereka chabosh aleka", veabel meolal beapar qarno veen naeh latet peer tachat eper. Abal bayyom hashsheni chayyab bitpillin, sheiqqar hamrirut eno ella yom echad, shenneemar: "veacharitah keyom mar". Umikkol maqom lo yaniach ad achar hanetz hachamma, sheaz kebar abar miqtzat zeman harauy lahanachat tepillin, veamrinan miqtzat hayyom kekullo, kemo shekkatub beyoreh dea siman shapach. Vekevan sheheniach — shub eno choletz, apillu bau panim chadashot, dehaynu menachamim chadashim shello hayu etmol. Abal lekattechilla lo yaniach bipnehem ad sheyyeleku lahem (vedin tepillin betisha beab yitbaer besiman taqanah):

Chatan veshoshebinayv vekol bene hachuppa bishat hammishteh — peturim, mippene shemmatzuy bahen shikrut veqallut rosh. Veap al pi shechayyabin biqriat shema — qorin qeriat shema belo tepillin. Veken peturin min hattepilla, lepi shemmittok simchat libbam lo yukelu lekavven, mah sheen ken biqriat shema shemmitzvat kavvanatah eno ella bepasuq rishon bediabad, ubeqal yukelu leyashsheb datam lekavven bepasuq rishon, vehashshear yomru belo kavvana. Veakshav sheen anu mekavvenim kol-kak battepilla gam belo simchat nissuin — en lechatan ulekol bene hachuppa liptor et atzman mehattepilla mechamat chesron kavvana, veken nohagin shemmapsiqin hammishteh keshemmaggia zeman tepilla. Venohagin gam ken lehaniach tepillin, shekkevan shemmapsiqin hammishteh veomedim umitpallelim — shub en lachosh leqallut rosh bishat hattepilla. Mah sheen ken baddorot harishonim shello hayu mapsiqin hammishteh kede lehitpallel vehayu qorin qeriat shema betok hammishteh — hayu peturin mittepillin shemma yabou bahen lide qallut rosh, shehu matzuy bishat hammishteh. Veyesh omerim shechatan veshoshebinayv vekol bene hachuppa haoseqim bammishteh — niqraim oseqim bemitzva leinyan sheppeturin mishshear mitzvot, laken hem peturim gam ken miqqeriat shema, veen tzarik lomar min hattepilla umin hattepillin apillu bizman hazzeh. Vehammeqel kisbara zo — lo hipsid, ap al pi shennohagin kassebara harishona. Velaken bimot haqqayitz shellipamim seudat hannissuin hi nimsheket ad habboqer — peturin mikkullam, ubilbad sheyyehe hechatan meseb immahem, sheaz hi mitzva lassebara haacharona:

Kotebe seta"m beshaa sheoseqin bimlaktan veken taggarehem vetaggare taggarehem — shehem loqechin kede lehotzian lemokran lemi shetztzarik lahem, veen kavvanatam kede lehistakker, veken kol haoseqim bimleket shamayim — peturin mehanachat tepillin kol hayyom, zulat bishat qeriat shema utepilla, kede leqabbel [alayv] ol malkut shamayim shelema, vegam shello yaidu edut sheqer beatzmam. Bammeh debarim amurim? Kesheenam oseqim bimlaktam bishat qeriat shema, abal im hem oseqim — enam tzerikim lehapsiq mishshum qeriat shema utepilla apillu im yaabor zemannam, ella shellekattechilla asurim lehatchil mishshehiggia samuk lizman qeriat shema (ayyen siman ab). Abal im hitchilu qodem laken, o apillu hitchilu beissur — en tzarik lehapsiq liqriat shema, ap al pi sheyyesh lahem shehut laasoq bimlaktam achar qeriat shema, uqeriat shema hi mitzva oberet, ap-al-pi-ken kol haoseq bemitzva patur mimmitzva acheret, apillu epshar lo leqayyem shettehen, lepi shekkol sheoseq bimlakto shel maqom — lo chiyyabto tora litroach uleqayyem mitzvot acherot ap al pi sheepshar lo. Velaken hamshammer et hammet — patur mittepillin umiqqeriat shema umittepilla umikkol hammitzvot, ap al pi sheyyakol leqayyem kol hammitzvot. Veken hachoper qeber lemet — patur mikkullam, ap al pi shennach meat, sheggam bishat nucho niqra adayin oseq bemitzva, sheal yede ken yitchazzeq kocho lachazor velachpor, velaken hu patur az ap al pi sheyyakol. Abal mi shellabush bitpillin, ap al pi shemmeqayyem mitzva — eno niqra oseq bemitzva lehippater mikkol hammitzvot ella beshaa shellobeshan, abal lo achar-kak kesheholek bahen kol hayyom. Veken mi shemmatza abedato shel chabero umeshammerah betebato ap al pi shemmeqayyem mitzva — eno niqra oseq bemitzva lehippater mikkol hammitzvot kol zeman heyotah betok tebato. Veken kol kayyotze bazeh. Vaapillu kesheoseq bemitzva achat venizdammena lo mitzva acheret, veyakol laasot shettehen keachat belo shum torach — "mihyot tob al tiqqare ra", veyetze yede shettehen. Velo ameru shekkol haoseq bemitzva patur min hammitzva, ella keshetztzarik litroach tircha baasiyya haacheret torach acher, abal lo keshettorach echad lishtehen ukedarko bammitzva harishona yakol latzet yede shettehen:

Hammitztaer, apillu mitztaer mippene hatztzinna, vekan kol mi sheen dato meyushshebet unekona alayv vei epshar lo leyashsheb dato — patur min hattepillin, mippene sheasur lehassiach dato min hattepillin. Abal im epshar lo leyashsheb dato — chayyab leyashsheb dato velahanichan, shehare abel chayyab miyyom sheni veelak ap al pi shemmitztaer veen dato meyushshebet, mippene sheyyesh lo leyashsheb dato veshello lehitztaer:

Haqqore battora — patur mehanachat tepillin kol hayyom, dehaynu sheen tzarik lehapsiq millimmudo lahanicham, (zulat) bishat qeriat shema utepilla, kede leqabbel alayv ol malkut shamayim shelema. Veap al pi shekkol mitzva shei epshar laasotah al yede acherim chayyab lehapsiq kede laasotah kemo sheyyitbaer beyoreh dea siman ram, mikkol maqom bitpillin neemar bahen: "leot al yadeka ulezikkaron ben eneka, lemaan tihyeh torat Hashem bepika", vezeh shekkebar yesh torat Hashem bepihu — en tzarik leot ulezikkaron. Veim ratza lehapsiq velahanichan — yakol gam ken lebarek alehem, sheap al pi sheppatur millehapsiq bishbilan, mikkol maqom kevan sherotzeh lehapsiq millimmudo — hare hu chayyab bitpillin miyyad shemmapsiq:
Lo yachalotz tepillayv bipne rabbo, shemmezalzel hu bikbodo shemmegalleh rosho bepanayv, ella yipneh letzad acher mippene emato veyachalotz shello bepanayv:

Haya tzarik litpillin velimzuza veen yado masseget liqnot shenehem — tepillin qodemin, mippene shehem chobat haggup. Veakshav sheen menichim tepillin ella bishat qeriat shema utepilla, im epshar lo lishol tepillin meacherim liqriat shema utepilla — mezuza qodemet shei epshar bishela. (Menuddeh, im muttar bitpillin — yitbaer beyoreh dea siman shalad):
